meta.description: triflux 초기 설정 및 진단. AskUserQuestion 기반 인터랙티브 위저드로 파일 동기화, HUD 설정, Codex 프로파일, CLI 진단, MCP 확인, 검색 MCP 설정을 수행합니다. Use when: setup, 설정, 설치, install, 초기화, 처음, 시작, wizard

copy.tagline: 按向导完成开发环境的初始配置与诊断检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想快速完成开发环境初始化并确认各项配置正常
copy.tagline_en: Set up and diagnose your dev environment with an interactive wizard.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a guided setup for your dev environment and want to catch configuration issues early.

howto.what: 装上后,当你要设置triflux时,Claude会启动一个交互式设置向导,分步骤完成文件同步、状态栏(HUD)设置、Codex配置文件、CLI诊断、MCP服务确认与搜索MCP配置等,并在过程中询问你的选择。
howto.when: 当你提到 setup、安装、初始化 等关键词,或要求进入向导时触发。

say.note: 会启动6步完整设置向导。
进入状态检查模式,只查看不修改。
引导选择搜索服务并配置API key。

howto.what_en: On setting up triflux, Claude runs an interactive wizard via AskUserQuestion covering file sync, HUD, Codex profiles, CLI diagnostics, MCP checks, and search MCP setup, asking the user to choose options at each step.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions setup, install, init, or similar keywords, or asks to start the wizard.

say_en.text: Run the triflux initial setup wizard.
say_en.note: It will start the 6-step guided setup.

say_en.text: Use tfx-setup to run a doctor check.
say_en.note: It runs diagnostics without changing settings.

say_en.text: I want to configure a search MCP server.
say_en.note: It will guide you to pick a search service and enter keys.
